questions.question: In Constitutional Bodies: ECI, CAG, UPSC & Finance Commission, this exam clue belongs to which area: "Conducts elections to Parliament, State Legislatures, and offices of President/VP. (Note: State Election Commission conducts local body polls). Multi-member body (1 CEC..."?
questions.explanation: Election Commission (Art 324): Conducts elections to Parliament, State Legislatures, and offices of President/VP. (Note: State Election Commission conducts local body polls). Multi-member body (1 CEC + 2 ECs). CEC has security of tenure like a SC judge (removed by impeachment). ECs can be removed by President on recommendation of CEC.

questions.question: In Constitutional Bodies: ECI, CAG, UPSC & Finance Commission, this exam clue belongs to which area: ""Guardian of the Public Purse". Audits accounts of Union and States. Appointment by President for 6 years or 65 years age. Security of tenure like SC judge..."?
questions.explanation: Comptroller and Auditor General (Art 148): "Guardian of the Public Purse". Audits accounts of Union and States. Appointment by President for 6 years or 65 years age. Security of tenure like SC judge. Salary/conditions cannot be varied to disadvantage. Not eligible for further office under Govt after retirement.

questions.question: In Constitutional Bodies: ECI, CAG, UPSC & Finance Commission, this exam clue belongs to which area: "UPSC: Central recruiting agency. Members appointed by President. Security of tenure (removed by President only on SC inquiry for misbehaviour). Advisory role (advice not..."?
questions.explanation: UPSC & SPSC (Art 315–323): UPSC: Central recruiting agency. Members appointed by President. Security of tenure (removed by President only on SC inquiry for misbehaviour). Advisory role (advice not binding). SPSC : State level. Members appointed by Governor but REMOVED ONLY BY PRESIDENT.

questions.question: In Constitutional Bodies: ECI, CAG, UPSC & Finance Commission, this exam clue belongs to which area: "Quasi-judicial body. 1 Chairman + 4 Members appointed by President every 5 years. Recommends : 1. Vertical Devolution (Centre to States). 2. Horizontal Devolution..."?
questions.explanation: Finance Commission (Art 280): Quasi-judicial body. 1 Chairman + 4 Members appointed by President every 5 years. Recommends : 1. Vertical Devolution (Centre to States). 2. Horizontal Devolution (Between States). 3. Grants-in-aid. Recommendations are ADVISORY (not binding). 15th FC (N.K. Singh) recommended 41% share for states.

topic_title: Constitutional Bodies: ECI, CAG, UPSC & Finance Commission
lesson_intro: Constitutional Bodies are the 'Pillars of Indian Democracy'. These institutions derive their authority directly from the Constitution, giving them a high degree of independence from the government of the day. Today we study the 'Big Four': the Election Commission of India (ECI), the Comptroller and Auditor General (CAG), the Union Public Service Commission (UPSC), and the Finance Commission. For a UPSC aspirant, understanding their 'Security of Tenure' and 'Functions' is vital, as these bodies are the gatekeepers of fair elections, financial accountability, and meritocracy in the civil services.
